# Welcome {#welcome .unnumbered}

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.path = "alberdilabr/figures/"
)
source("alberdilabr/setup.R")
```

This publication records the **Microflora Danica data panel** staged for a
worked example in the hilldiv3 manuscript. The current release contains the
sample and genome metadata, a representative MAG abundance matrix, and a
phylogenetic tree. The analysis chapters will be added as that work is run.

The [staged data](#staged-data) chapter describes the panel, its provenance,
and how to verify it. The source files and preparation scripts are in the
[GitHub repository](https://github.com/alberdilab/hilldiv3-ms).

## Rebuild this site {.unnumbered}

After cloning, restore the R package versions in `renv.lock` with
`renv::restore()`. Then, from the repository root, run:

```r
bookdown::render_book("index.Rmd")
```

The rendered site is written to `_site/`. The GitHub Actions workflow builds
the site from source and publishes it to GitHub Pages.
